title: Pedestrian Deaths Rose 77% While Traffic Deaths Fell
hook: Roads got safer overall—but not for people walking.
closing: Overall traffic safety gains mean less when walking keeps getting deadlier.
question: Do you feel safe walking?

segments.say: US traffic deaths fell to 40,990, but the improvement did not reach everyone using the road.
Pedestrian deaths jumped 77%, roughly three times the growth of other traffic deaths.
Pedestrians accounted for about one in six traffic deaths, making walking a growing share of road danger.
